subject: Broken Goron's Sword
text: Trade the Poacher's Saw to the man across the broken bridge in Gerudo Valley to obtain the Broken Goron's Sword.

evidence.quote:
He'll offer you the BROKEN GORON'S 
SWORD in return for the Poacher's Saw.

subject: Nocturne of Shadow
text: Link learns the Nocturne of Shadow during a scene upon entering Kakariko Village.

evidence.quote:
When you arrive here there is a scene.  Here is where you will learn the 
NOCTURNE OF SHADOW, the song which will warp you to the Shadow Temple, our 
next destination but only after we complete the Biggoron Sword sidequest.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: Break the rock beside the bomb flower at night using the Megaton Hammer to find Gold Skulltula [079].

evidence.quote:
During the night you should hear 
something crawling around here, equip the Megaton Hammer and break the rock 
beside the bomb flower to find GOLD SKULLTULA [079].

subject: Prescription
text: Biggoron gives Link the Prescription to get Eyedrops from King Zora.

evidence.quote:
He says that before he can repair anything, he's going to need some 
Eyedrops from King Zora.  In return he gives you the PRESCRIPTION you need.

subject: Eyeball Frog
text: Presenting the Prescription to King Zora yields the Eyeball Frog.

evidence.quote:
stand on the platform before the king and use the Prescription.  He 
will give you the EYEBALL FROG which is needed in order to fill the 
prescription, get it to the Lake Hylia Laboratory as soon as possible.

subject: World's Finest Eye Drops
text: Using the Eyeball Frog beside the old man in the Lake Hylia Laboratory yields the World's Finest Eye Drops.

evidence.quote:
Head 
for the lab and go inside, use the frog beside the old man here (approximate 
time remaining: plenty).  He'll give you WORLD'S FINEST EYE DROPS.

subject: Claim Check
text: Giving the Eyedrops to Biggoron atop Death Mountain Trail earns the Claim Check.

evidence.quote:
Climb the wall after they are dead and use the 
Eyedrops in front of the Biggoron to get the CLAIM CHECK for the sword.

subject: Biggoron's Sword
text: Playing the Sun's Song about five times and speaking to Biggoron grants the Biggoron's Sword.

evidence.quote:
Play the 
Sun's Song about five times or so and speak to him again to get the BIGGORON'S 
SWORD.

subject: Nocturne of Shadow
text: Playing the Nocturne of Shadow (left, right, right, A, left, right, down) warps Link to the graveyard.

evidence.quote:
to get there simply play the 
Nocturne of Shadow (left, right, right, A, left, right, down) on your Ocarina 
and it will take you to the graveyard.

subject: Shadow Temple Entrance
text: Casting Din's Fire from the center platform in the graveyard lights all torches to open the Shadow Temple entrance.

evidence.quote:
Jump onto the 
centre platform and equip the Din's Fire spell, use it here and every last one
of the torches will be lit.  Now the door to the Shadow Temple is open.

subject: Large Chest
text: A large chest behind hidden doors in the Shadow Temple contains the Dungeon Map.

evidence.quote:
Open the large chest in this room to acquire the 
DUNGEON MAP for this dungeon.

subject: Dead Hand
text: Two jump attacks with the Biggoron's Sword are enough to defeat the miniboss.

evidence.quote:
If you have the Biggoron's Sword then two jump 
attacks alone will be enough to take this enemy down.

subject: Large Chest
text: Defeating the miniboss spawns a large treasure chest containing the Hover Boots.

evidence.quote:
When you kill him, a 
large treasure chest appears in this room which contains the HOVER BOOTS, 
special shoes which allow you to hover above the ground but give absolutely no 
traction.

subject: Skull Pillars
text: Using the Lens of Truth identifies the only real skull pillar, and pointing the statue toward it opens the door.

evidence.quote:
equip the Lens of Truth and take a 
look at the pillars surrounding the statue in the middle.  One of them will 
not disappear when you look at it, all of the others will.  Push the object 
coming out the side of the statue to point in the direction of the real skull 
and the door will open.

subject: Large Chest
text: Defeating the two mummies causes a large treasure chest containing the Compass to appear.

evidence.quote:
totally waste the two 
mummies in order to make a large treasure chest appear.  Inside this chest is 
the dungeon's COMPASS.

subject: Treasure Chest
text: Collecting all Silver Rupees in the spinning sickle room opens a gate to a small chest with a Small Key.

evidence.quote:
Once you have all of the Silver Rupees, 
go through the now-open gate and check inside the little treasure chest to get 
a SMALL KEY from it.

subject: East Path Wall
text: The eastern wall must be destroyed with a bomb to reach the locked door beyond.

evidence.quote:
There is one more path you haven't take it, but instead of simply walking 
through the wall, you must destroy it using a bomb.

subject: Chest
text: Eliminating all enemies in the spinning death blade sickle room opens a gate to a chest containing a Blue Rupee.

evidence.quote:
When all 
enemies are eliminated the gate will open and you can go inside to find a BLUE 
RUPEE in the chest and a GOLD SKULLTULA [080] crawling on the wall.

subject: Wall
text: Gold Skulltula [080] is crawling on the wall inside the gated alcove of the hidden sickle room.

evidence.quote:
When all 
enemies are eliminated the gate will open and you can go inside to find a BLUE 
RUPEE in the chest and a GOLD SKULLTULA [080] crawling on the wall.

subject: Laser Turret
text: The fifth Silver Rupee in the moving platform area is revealed by blowing up the central laser turret.

evidence.quote:
Jump across again and begin collecting the 
Silver Rupees here in this area, the fifth one can be found by blowing up the 
laser turret in the centre here.

subject: Spike Platforms
text: Pushing the movable block along the track under the spike platforms stops both from dropping down.

evidence.quote:
Pull it out from the wall and place it on the 
track.  Begin pushing it along below the spike platforms.  When you get past 
the first one, push it only a little bit so it blocks the second one, bit is 
still partially under the first one.

subject: Small Chest
text: A small chest inside the right-hand jail cell contains Arrows.

evidence.quote: Make a right into the jail cell and open the small chest to get ARROWS.

subject: Jail Cell
text: Gold Skulltula [081] is located inside the cell opposite the arrow chest.

evidence.quote:
Turn around and enter the opposite cell, here you will find GOLD SKULLTULA 
[081].

subject: Small Chest
text: Hopping across the spike platform to the ledge reveals a small chest containing a Blue Rupee.

evidence.quote:
Hop over 
the spike thing to the opposite side and open the small chest containing BLUE 
RUPEE.

subject: Small Chest
text: Stepping on the floor button spawns a small chest on the opposite side containing a Small Key.

evidence.quote:
After that turn around and step on the button, it makes a small chest 
appear on the opposite side.  Go back across to it and open the chest to get a 
SMALL KEY.

subject: Small Chest
text: A small treasure chest in the invisible spikes room yields a Blue Rupee.

evidence.quote:
Open the small treasure chest to 
acquire a BLUE RUPEE and then proceed through the western door.

subject: Flaming Skull
text: Gold Skulltula [082] is found behind the flaming skull.

evidence.quote:
Behind 
the flaming skull you will find a GOLD SKULLTULA [082], be sure to get that.

subject: Flaming Skull
text: Blowing up the flaming skull with a Bomb Flower drops a Small Key.

evidence.quote:
notice there are some Bomb Flowers in this room, lift up 
one of the bombs and throw it on top of the flaming skull in order to blow it 
up.  A SMALL KEY will fall out of the broken wreckage for you to pick up.
